all.src: Equal wings; OI >= 500 and per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid) on all three strikes.

management.src: Close at 50% of max profit, i.e. when the structure can be bought back for <= 50% of the credit received.
Hard stop: close if the mark-to-market loss reaches 2.0x the credit received.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if either short call is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.

DIVIDEND GUARD: close before the ex-dividend date whenever the lower short call is ITM and its extrinsic value is below the declared dividend. This is the highest-probability early assignment path for this structure.
Close no later than 2 DTE in all cases; the tent's max loss zone sharpens exactly when gamma is largest.

unexpressed.text: Credit received must be >= 25% of wing width; otherwise the risk/reward is not worth the assignment exposure.
unexpressed.reason: assignment prose: the machine-readable part is the guard, which is compiled separately where the sentence gives a time or a threshold

unexpressed.text: IV rank of the underlying < 25 at entry (read from a 252-day IV percentile computed locally).

safety_gaps.why: the structure has 2 short leg(s) and no compiled assignment guard. These are AMERICAN options on shares: a short that finishes in the money delivers 100 shares per contract the account never sized for.
